description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) LIGHTNING WRATH (Dread Host, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_cus11e_c5_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test. In the Pile In step the player real-clicks Custodian Guard A's row in the step panel: the new unit_selected_to_pile_in window opens before the move; a real click on Use spends 1 CP and rolls D3; the Pile In dialog then opens with a D3+3" (4-6") limit instead of 3".

steps.comment: setup privilege: straight to the phase under test
a window not under test (if any) is declined
REAL click on the unit's Pile In row
REAL click on the stratagem's Use button
the pile-in cap is the rolled D3+3
the Game Log names the stratagem
